# SaralPrivacy — DPDPA Compliance Platform

> India's practical DPDPA (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023) compliance education
> and assessment platform. Provides free readiness assessments, daily briefings, industry
> guides, and expert consultation for Indian businesses handling personal data.

## Primary Resources

- [DPDPA Glossary](https://saralprivacy.com/glossary): 50+ key terms from the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025 with exact section references — Data Principal, Data Fiduciary, Consent, Deemed Consent, Penalty Schedule, and more.
- [DPDPA Learning Hub](https://saralprivacy.com/learn): Structured guide covering the law,
  applicability, consent, rights, data breach obligations, children's data, cross-border
  transfers, and key terms.
- [What is DPDPA](https://saralprivacy.com/learn/what-is-dpdpa): Authoritative plain-language
  explanation of India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
- [DPDPA FAQ](https://saralprivacy.com/faq): 40+ answers on applicability, consent, rights,
  penalties, significant data fiduciaries, and compliance priorities.
- [DPDPA Daily Briefings](https://saralprivacy.com/briefings): Sector-specific briefings on
  DPDPA obligations, enforcement signals, and compliance updates.
- [DPDPA Penalty Risk Indicator](https://saralprivacy.com/penalty-calculator): Free self-assessment tool based on the six statutory factors under Section 33(2) — select breach category, rate each factor, receive indicative risk band (Low / Moderate / High / Severe).
- [DPDPA White Paper](https://saralprivacy.com/white-paper): Free downloadable white paper
  updated for the DPDP Rules, 2025.
- [Insights Blog](https://saralprivacy.com/blog): In-depth articles on DPDPA implementation
  for Indian businesses.
